title: Deleting a todo in the Active filter removes the wrong item
observed_steps: 00:14 user clicks the Active filter — list shows 'Walk dog', 'Pay rent'
00:17 user clicks the × next to 'Pay rent'
expected: 'Pay rent' is removed; 'Walk dog' remains in Active and 'Buy milk' remains in Done.
actual: 'Walk dog' disappears instead. Switching to All shows 'Buy milk' and 'Pay rent' — 'Walk dog' is gone.
evidence_timestamps: 00:18 — list re-renders with only 'Pay rent' visible
root_cause_hypothesis: render() iterates visibleTodos() and binds the delete button to deleteTodo(i) using the index within the FILTERED array, but deleteTodo() calls todos.splice(index, 1) on the UNFILTERED array. When a filter hides earlier items, the indices diverge and the wrong todo is removed. toggleTodo() correctly uses the id; deleteTodo should as well.
